description: Merged numerical candidate: original 160-bin certificate outside |mu|<0.025, with refined near-zero bins using added frequencies and cos+asin phase inequalities. Numerical root-antiderivative only, not interval-rigorous.
normalization: p(t)=int h(x)(1-h(x+t)) dx on [-2,2], int p=1; certificate q=1+sum lambda_j(B_j-phi_j), so int p q >= 1 in the stated mean bin.
